SENSITIVE BUT UNCLASSIFIED JUSTIFICATION AND APPROVAL FOR OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION (OVERSEAS CONTRACTING ACTIVITIES) I recommend that the Department of State use other than full and open competition for the acquisition of Hotel Rooms including internet facilities in support of the VIP visit from December 8, 2025, to December 20, 2025, tentatively. Estimated amount for services is

AED 119,178 (USD 32,447)

1. Nature and/or description of the action being approved. Hotel accommodation in a best secured location in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, in support of VIP visit. The Ritz-Carlton Abu Dhabi, Grand Canal, located at Khor Al Maqta’a, Abu Dhabi City, PO Box 91888, Abu Dhabi, UAE, has been cleared by security detail after their assessment on safety and security, logistics, and other national security requirements being considered for the VIP visit based.

2. A description of the supplies or services required to meet the agency’s needs. Total 100 Room Nights (estimated) are required with internet/Wi-Fi facilities. A Purchase Order (PO) will be awarded to The Ritz-Carlton hotel Abu Dhabi, marking the period of performance from December 8, 2025, to December 20, 2025, for the same. The PO will be modified later for additions and/or deletions as the check-in/check-out dates are tentative, and rooming list is still not final which is to be confirmed later. The hotel shall bill for actual room nights but shall not exceed the period of performance and/or total number of room nights to be confirmed via the PO. In case additional room nights are required as per the final rooming list, which is to be confirmed later, then the hotel shall request for a new or modified PO or written confirmation from the Contracting Officer before providing such additional room nights.

3. An identification of the statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition. FAR 6.302-6 National security. Authority citation: 10 U.S.C.2304(c)(6) or 41 U.S.C.3304(a)(6) Disclosure of the agency’s needs in advance, or public posting in advance, would compromise the national security.

4. A demonstration that the proposed contractor’s unique qualifications or the nature of the acquisition requires use of the authority cited. The selection of the Ritz-Carlton Abu Dhabi was made by the security detail lead officer. The hotel meets all the requirements in support of VIP visit with its unique requirements for safety, security, logistics, and other factors not to compromise national security. The hotel covers some serious square footage with best class facilities and is equipped to cater any needs for such highlevel VIP visits.

5. A description of efforts made to ensure that offers are solicited from as many potential sources as is practicable. The description should include whether a SAM notice was or will be publicized, as required by FAR 5.2, and if not, which exception under FAR 5.202 applies (e.g., blanket waiver provided in DOSAR 605.202-70).

SENSITIVE BUT UNCLASSIFIED

Due to National security and exception in FAR 5.202.(a).(1) this solicitation cannot be posted but the JOFOC may be published in SAM.gov (GPE) if required.

6. A determination by the Contracting Officer that the anticipated cost to the Government will be fair and reasonable. The Ritz-Carlton Abu Dhabi has provided best possible rate to meet the security requirements for the hotel room/facilities. The daily rate to the ADFW (Abu Dhabi Finance Week) event (blackout season) from December 8 to December 11 is within the post per diem rate. The rate is fair and reasonable for such unique requirements and facilities during such time. The advance team has technically cleared the hotel and accepted the booking rate.

7. Any other facts supporting the use of other than full and open competition. This hotel meets and exceeds the security standards for high-level visits. Additionally, the hotel can accommodate the size of motorcade required for this visit.

8. A listing of sources, if any, that expressed, in writing, an interest in the acquisition. The rates provided by other interested sources are not the best value to USG.

9. A statement of the actions, if any, the agency may take to remove or overcome any barriers to competition before any subsequent acquisition for the supplies or services required. None.

CERTIFICATIONS

I certify that the information in this justification is accurate and contains complete data necessary to support the recommendation for other than full and open competition to the best of my knowledge and belief.

_____________Signed____________________ _________December 4, 2025____________ Matthew Edward (Control Officer) Date:

I certify that this justification is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief. Based on my assessment, I conclude that other than full and open competition is justified, and the proposed price is fair and reasonable.
